newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-REDSKINS NAME MIKE NOLAN DEFENSIVE COORDINATOR.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-REDSKINS NAME MIKE NOLAN DEFENSIVE COORDINATOR.

text.p: The Washington Redskins, who ranked 28th of 30 NFL teams in defence, named Mike Nolan as their new defensive coordinator on Monday.
Nolan, who had served in the same position with the New York Giants since 1993, will replace Ron Lynn, who was fired after the past season.
Nolan had one year left on his contract with the Giants, but Dan Reeves was fired as head coach and general manager George Young gave the Redskins permission to talk to Nolan.

"Mike was our first choice to be defensive coordinator," said Redskins head coach Norv Turner. "He brings experience and a record of playoff success as an assistant coach with the Denver Broncos and as a coordinator with the New York Giants."

Lynn had been Washington's defensive coordinator since 1994. But the Redskins' defence ranked last in the NFL against the run and 20th against the pass. Washington allowed 142.2 yards per game rushing and 215.5 yards passing.
The Redskins were 7-1 at the midway point of the season, but managed only two wins in their last eight games and finished 9-7 and out of the playoffs.
